summary: Premium UI polish (Home / AI Chat / Profile) validated on mobile viewport 390x844 via guest login. Backend smoke: GET /api/, POST /api/auth/guest, GET /api/todos, GET /api/focus, GET /api/habits all return 200 with correct schema. HOME: hero + quote-card ('TODAY'S SPARK'), progress-card (overall %, streak pill, 3 progress bars Tasks/Focus/Habits), all 6 quick-action tiles (Notes/To-Do/Habits/Focus/AI Chat/Expenses) render and navigate to /notes /todos /habits /focus /ai/chat /expenses correctly. 'Recently used' horizontal chip appears after first tap of a quick action (verified with quick-notes -> recent-notes chip shown). 'Coming soon' chip row renders. Pull-to-refresh handler wired via RefreshControl (web preview can't fire touch pull, but load() is invoked on focus and re-fetches todos/focus/habits). AI CHAT: typing-indicator bubble appeared during Gemini call, then disappeared when reply arrived. Assistant message showed both Copy and Regenerate buttons; Copy tap did not crash (expo-clipboard) and Regenerate correctly dropped the last assistant message and re-fetched (msg-assistant count remained 1 after regenerate = last reply replaced). Starter prompts on empty chat also work. PROFILE: All 18 testIDs verified visible - Preferences (Theme/Notifications/Language/App Lock), Sync & Storage (Backup/Storage/Restore), Community (Rate/Share/Feedback/Help/Support), Data & Privacy (Privacy/Terms), About (Version/Developer), Premium upgrade CTA and Sign out. Toast overlay confirmed after Restore tap. REGRESSION SWEEP (21 routes) all load without red-box: /todos, /habits, /focus, /expenses, /notes, /reminders, /pdf, /premium, /qr, /voice, /calc, /calc/scientific, /calc/emi, /calc/sip, /calc/currency, /calc/unit, /ai/tool/translator, /ai/tool/grammar, /ai/tool/summarize, /ai/tool/email, /ai/tool/study. 0 pageerror events captured across the entire test session. Bottom tab bar switches Home/Tools/Profile correctly. Only cosmetic console warnings observed (deprecated 'shadow*' style props from RN Web + 'Image style.resizeMode is deprecated' + expo-notifications web-not-supported notices) - all pre-existing, not introduced by this polish.

issues: Top-line date ('Sunday, August 5') sits partially behind status-bar area on tight iPhone SE viewport - readable but slightly clipped in first ~2px. Cosmetic; not blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warns: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Appears repeatedly during app load. Cosmetic - RN 0.76+ warns when shadow{Color,Offset,Opacity,Radius} used on web. Consider migrating shadowed cards (progressCard/contRow/tile) to a cross-platform elevation helper. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(main)/home.tsx

Console warns: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' - heroBg uses resizeMode inside StyleSheet. Move `resizeMode: "cover"` from styles.heroBg to <Image resizeMode="cover" />. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(main)/home.tsx:362
'[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' Pre-existing web-only limitation, not from this polish.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Migrate shadow* style props on progressCard / contRow / tile / recentChip to boxShadow (or cross-platform Platform.select) to silence RN-Web warnings.
(Nice-to-have) Move `resizeMode: 'cover'` from styles.heroBg into the <Image> prop to satisfy expo-image deprecation warning. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(main)/home.tsx:158-362.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx: `load()` runs on both useEffect and useFocusEffect — the useEffect first-run + focus-run causes 2 back-to-back /todos+/focus+/habits fetches on cold start. Not a bug (idempotent GETs) but consider removing the plain useEffect since useFocusEffect fires on mount too.

chat.tsx regenerate() slices to `lastIndexOf('assistant')` and re-sends the last user message; if a user message was the very last item (e.g. after an error), regenerate won't be shown (guarded by `index === messages.length - 1` on assistant bubbles). Behavior looks intended.
profile.tsx showToast uses a stateful 2.4s auto-dismiss; if user taps multiple rows rapidly, later toast messages replace earlier ones — acceptable UX.
haptics.ts correctly guards with Platform.OS === 'web' early-return; safe on preview.
